items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: You mentioned that you went with Gaspar's big band.

ctx.x: Yeah, we worked with -- I can't think of the drummer's name. We were all kids. I mean, we didn't pay much attention to anything like that. We was out for fun more than anything else, which we did have a lot of fun.
You mentioned that you went with Gaspar's big band. What was his full name?
His full name was -- oh, God.
